summary: Apartment blocks within 8-12 m along the whole kerb, plus no-stopping and bus zones.
reasons: No Stopping and Bus Zone signs

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks line the west side at 8-12 m for the full length; more across the road.

drivers.traffic: Busy through street near Indooroopilly, steady passing traffic.
